description: This file defines a connectors service module that handles CRUD operations and token association for connectors, providing functions for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting connector records. It imports database interaction functions from another module and exposes an interface for managing connector data.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_connector_record( tenant_id: str, provider: str, auth_method: str, label: str | None, config: Dict[str, Any], token_id: str | None, )
methods.description: Creates a new connector record in the database with provided parameters.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_connector_records(tenant_id: str | None = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of connector records, optionally filtered by tenant ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any]|None get_connector_record(connector_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific connector record by its ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any]|None update_connector_record(connector_id: str, updates: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates an existing connector record with given modifications.

methods.name: bool delete_connector_record(connector_id: str)
methods.description: Deletes a connector record by its ID.
